If the region of the OSS bucket is not specified, the region of the OSS bucket is the same as the value of the RegionId parameter.

parameters.help_en:
The operation settings for updating the stack group.

This parameter includes the following fields:

{"FailureToleranceCount": N}

  The number maximum concurrent accounts in which stack failures are tolerated in each region. If the number of failed stacks exceeds this value, the operation in the region stops. If the operation in a region stops, the operation does not continue in other regions.
  
  Valid values of N: 0 to 20.

  Default value: 0.

{"FailureTolerancePercentage": N}

  The percentage maximum concurrent accounts in which stack failures are tolerated in each region. If the percentage of failed stacks exceeds this value, the operation in the region stops.

  Valid values of N: 0 to 100. If the calculated percentage is not an integer, Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) rounds down the percentage.

  Default value: 0.

{"MaxConcurrentCount": N}

  The maximum number maximum concurrent accounts in which stacks can be deployed at the same time in each region.

  Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

  Default value: 1.

{"MaxConcurrentPercentage": N}

  The maximum percentage maximum concurrent accounts in which stacks can be deployed at the same time in each region.

  Valid values of N: 1 to 100. If the calculated percentage is not an integer, ROS rounds down the percentage.

  Default value: 1.

{"RegionConcurrencyType": N}

  The region-level concurrency type for deploying stack instances. Valid values:

SEQUENTIAL (default): deploys stack instances in the specified regions one by one. Only one region is deployed at a time.

PARALLEL: deploys stack instances in all specified regions in parallel.

Separate multiple parameters with commas (,).

You cannot specify both MaxConcurrentCount and MaxConcurrentPercentage.
You cannot specify both FailureToleranceCount and FailureTolerancePercentage
parameters.help_zh:
更新资源栈组的操作设置。

包含以下参数：

{"FailureToleranceCount": N}

  容错数。每个地域中资源栈可以失败的账号数，超过该数字将停止该地域中的操作。如果停止了一个地域中的操作，此操作在其他地域中不继续执行。
  
   N的取值范围：0~20。

   若不指定FailureToleranceCount，则默认为0。

{"FailureTolerancePercentage": N}

   容错百分比。每个地域中资源栈可以失败的账号数占总账号数的百分比，超过该百分比将停止该地域中的操作。

   N的取值范围：0~100。百分比不是整数时，ROS会向下取整。

   若不指定FailureTolerancePercentage，则默认为0。

{"MaxConcurrentCount": N}

   最大并发账号数。每个地域中可同时部署资源栈的账号数。

   N的取值范围：1~20。

   若不指定MaxConcurrentCount，则默认为1。

{"MaxConcurrentPercentage": N}最大并发账号百分比。

   每个地域中可同时部署资源栈的账号数占总账号数的百分比。

   N的取值范围：1~100。百分比不是整数时，ROS会向下取整。

   若不指定MaxConcurrentPercentage，则默认为1。
{"RegionConcurrencyType": N}
部署资源栈实例的地域级别并发类型，取值：
     - SEQUENTIAL （默认值）： 根据地域顺序依次在指定的每个地域部署，同一时间只在一个地域部署。

     - PARALLEL ：在所有指定的地域内并行部署。

多个参数之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

不能同时指定MaxConcurrentCount和MaxConcurrentPercentage。  
不能同时指定FailureToleranceCount和FailureTolerancePercentage

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) administrator role that is assumed by ROS when you create a stack group with self-managed permissions. If you do not specify this parameter, AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole is used by default. ROS assumes this role to further assume the execution role (AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole) and manage the stacks that correspond to the stack instances in the stack group.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
创建具有自助管理权限的资源栈组时，需指定的供ROS扮演的RAM管理员角色名称。若不指定，则使用AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole作为默认值。ROS以该角色身份进一步扮演执行角色（AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole）来操作资源栈组中资源栈实例所对应的资源栈。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: administration_role_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM execution role that is assumed by the administrator role (AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole) when you create a stack group with self-managed permissions. If you do not specify this parameter, AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole is used by default. ROS assumes this role to manage the stacks that correspond to the stack instances in the stack group.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
创建具有自助管理权限的资源栈组时，需指定的供管理员角色（AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole）扮演的RAM执行角色名称。若不指定，则使用AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole作为默认值。ROS以该角色身份来操作资源栈组中资源栈实例所对应的资源栈。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）

parameters.help_en:
The authorization pattern.

Valid values:

SELF_MANAGED (default): the self-managed permissions pattern. If you use this pattern, you must manually create RAM roles in the administrator account and the execution accounts to establish a trust relationship between the two, and then perform stack deployment in the execution accounts.

SERVICE_MANAGED: the service-managed permissions pattern. If you use this pattern, ROS performs automatic creation of service-linked (associate) roles for the administrator account and the execution accounts. The administrator account performs stack deployment in the execution accounts by using the service-linked roles.

If the stack group already contains stack instances, you cannot change the authorization pattern.
When you use the service-managed permissions pattern for stack deployment, the current account must be the management account or a delegated administrator account of a resource directory (folder), and trusted access must be enabled. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308253.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/298229.html
parameters.help_zh:
授权模式。

取值：

SELF_MANAGED（默认值）：自助管理权限模式。使用该模式时，您需要事先在管理员账号和目标账号中手动创建RAM角色，建立二者的信任关系，然后在目标账号中部署资源栈。

SERVICE_MANAGED：服务管理权限模式。使用该模式时，ROS会为管理员账号和目标账号自动创建服务关联角色，管理员账号通过服务关联角色在目标账号中部署资源栈。

如果当前资源栈组下已有资源栈实例，则不允许更换授权模式。
当您使用服务管理权限模式部署资源栈时，当前账号必须是资源目录的企业管理账号或委派管理员账号，且已开启可信访问。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308253.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/298229.html
parameters.name: permission_model

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-deployment.

Valid values:

true: enables auto-deployment. After auto-deployment is enabled, if a member account is added to the target folder, the stack group automatically deploys a stack instance to the account. If a member account is removed from the target folder, the stack group automatically deletes the stack instance in the account.

false: disables auto-deployment. After auto-deployment is disabled, stack instances do not change when member accounts in the target folder change
fields.help_zh:
启用或者禁用自动部署。

取值：

true：启用自动部署。启用自动部署后，如果目标资源夹中新增了成员账号，资源栈组会自动将资源栈实例部署到该账号。如果目标资源夹中删除了成员账号，则资源栈组会自动删除该账号中的资源栈实例。

false：禁用自动部署。禁用自动部署后，目标资源夹中成员账号变动时资源栈实例不会发生变化
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the stacks in member accounts when member accounts are removed from the target folder.

Valid values:

true: retains the stacks.

false: deletes the stacks.

RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval is required when Enabled is set to true
fields.help_zh:
目标资源夹中删除成员账号时，是否保留成员账号中的资源栈。

取值：

true：保留资源栈。

false：删除资源栈。

当Enabled为true时，RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval必选
fields.name: retain_stacks_on_account_removal
